sources.summary: La Feria De Diseño Medellín powered by idd cologne is a professional platform connecting Latin American design with international markets. From September 10–12, 2026, the event will bring together brands, architects, interior designers, buyers, developers, distributors and industry leaders at Plaza Mayor Medellín. Its exhibition and business agenda covers furniture, lighting, kitchens, architecture, interior design, wellness and décor, creating new opportunities across Latin America and the Caribbean.
